title: Gypensapogenin I Suppresses Cell Proliferation in Triple-Negative Breast Cancer Via Triggering the Closure of AKT/GSK3beta/beta-Catenin and Notch-1 Signaling Pathways.
authors: Tan, Hongyan; Li, Minjie; Han, Linlin; Zhao, Yuqing; Zhang, Xiaoshu
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 研究天然皂苷Gyp I抑制三阴性乳腺癌增殖的机制，涉及信号通路而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Jiaogulan (Gynostemma pentaphyllum) tea is a functional food that is commercially available worldwide. Gypensapogenin I (Gyp I), which is a natural damarane-type saponin, was obtained from the hydrolysates of total gypenosides. The present research was performed to investigate the potential antiproliferation effect of Gyp I in MDA-MB-231 cells and the underlying mechanisms. Here, we found that Gyp I attenuated survival, inhibited proliferation, and induced apoptosis in MDA-MB-231 cells. Target prediction by binding molecule docking and western blot assays confirmed the mechanism by which Gyp I inhibited the proliferation of breast cancer cells via the AKT/GSK3beta/beta-catenin signaling pathway. We also showed that Gyp I exhibited superior in vivo efficacy that was dose dependent. Tumor tissue transcriptome analysis indicated that Gyp I could decrease the expression levels of NOTCH1 and HES1, which was in contrast to the effect on MAML and NUMBL, indicating that our compound hindered the activation of the Notch-1 signaling pathway. In summary, we report for the first time that Gyp I shows excellent anti-breast cancer activity in vivo and in vitro and that its pathway of action is related to the AKT/GSK3beta/beta-catenin and Notch-1 signaling pathways. Therefore, Jiaogulan tea can not only be used as a health food but also possesses the possibility to treat triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC).
abstract_zh: 绞股蓝（Gynostemma pentaphyllum）茶是一种在全球范围内商业化的功能性食品。绞股蓝皂苷I（Gyp I）是一种天然达玛烷型皂苷，从总绞股蓝皂苷的水解产物中获得。本研究旨在探讨Gyp I在MDA-MB-231细胞中的潜在抗增殖作用及其潜在机制。我们发现，Gyp I减弱了MDA-MB-231细胞的存活能力，抑制了其增殖，并诱导了细胞凋亡。通过结合分子对接和蛋白质印迹实验进行的靶点预测证实了Gyp I通过AKT/GSK3beta/beta-catenin信号通路抑制乳腺癌细胞增殖的机制。我们还表明，Gyp I在体内表现出剂量依赖性的优异疗效。肿瘤组织转录组分析显示，Gyp I可降低NOTCH1和HES1的表达水平，这与对MAML和NUMBL的影响相反，表明我们的化合物阻碍了Notch-1信号通路的激活。总之，我们首次报道Gyp I在体内和体外均表现出优异的抗乳腺癌活性，其作用途径与AKT/GSK3beta/beta-catenin和Notch-1信号通路相关。因此，绞股蓝茶不仅可用作保健食品，还具有治疗三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）的可能性。
